title: Azusawa Kohane — I'll Tell You Lots!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... Where do I begin...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I don't really know where to start.
There's just so much that I've thought, felt and experienced until now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I understand.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, why don't you start by telling me about what you felt when you decided to start singing...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...!
That seems like a good starting point.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I decided to start singing after seeing An perform at Weekend Garage.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... I think that's about everything.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's amazing to see just how much happened after I decided to start singing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Learning how to perform live in front of an audience was one thing, but I forgot how my parents were initially worried about my safety...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I forgot about that too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Didn't we invite them to an event in order to get them to see what street music is really about...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanted them to understand that there was nothing dangerous about what I was doing or where I was going.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I was so happy when my dad came to see us perform. Although, hearing him shout my name was a little embarrassing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, and we all introduced ourselves to him afterwards. Remember what happened with Akito when we did?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito was so polite that her dad thought he was much older than the rest of us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That was so funny.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Geez...
You guys don't need to remember stuff like that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, I'm really glad that my parents became more comfortable with what I was doing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I was also a little worried, but it's good that everything worked out in the end.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That being said, Azusawa, your dad seems like a very kind person.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-You think so...?
Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He does show his kindness in a lot of ways. Like teaching me about photography and buying me cakes from the store.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But he does also worry a lot sometimes...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And he has every right to worry!
I mean, if I had a daughter as cute as you, I wouldn't want anything happening to her!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's also proof that the apple doesn't fall far from the tree. You both seem nice and polite on the outside...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you don't hold back when push comes to shove...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I-I'm like him...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line: Honey, look! Count Pearl just shed his skin! Isn't it beautiful...? We should order some sushi to celebrate!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line: Stop right there, Kohane! Let me take a photo of you...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line: Okay, got it! See how it looks like Phenny is sitting on top of your shoulder? How cute it that...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are we really that alike...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh?
No, I'm sorry! I take that back...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What? No, I don't dislike the thought!
It just sort of makes a lot of different emotions stir inside of me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But more than anything, I think I feel happy because I've always somewhat wanted to grow up to be like my dad...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. My dad always gets really excited whenever he talks about photography or Count Pearl... So excited that he forgets about everything else that's happening.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I've always envied how he's so passionate about certain things.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
So you've always admired the way he lives his life and looked up to him in that respect.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You really have a great dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, Kohane, you're also a lot like your mom...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She is?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
For one, you're both really cute!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When you showed me that picture of her the other day, I thought you were both just too adorable!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: S-Stop it, An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, my mom would really enjoy hearing you say that—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I thought we were here to talk about our feelings and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Oh.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Umm... Sorry, Aoyagi.
I'm guessing none of that really helps...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, that's not true.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As I mentioned a little earlier, I want to do everything in my power to understand everyone's thoughts and feelings.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, anything regarding your upbringing, your family and those around you are valuable pieces of information to me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If possible, I'd like you to tell me more.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thanks, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, I'll tell you more about my family.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... What haven't I mentioned?
